description: Source code defining quantized and functional modules for PyTorch, including classes for float and quantized operations, with methods for various tensor operations and serialization.

classes.name: FloatFunctional
classes.description: State collector class for float tensor operations, providing methods like add, mul, cat, add_relu, etc.

classes.name: FXFloatFunctional
classes.description: Module to replace FloatFunctional before FX graph mode quantization, with similar operation methods.

classes.name: QFunctional
classes.description: Wrapper class for quantized tensor operations, supporting add, mul, cat, add_relu, and serialization methods.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs addition of two tensors or tensor and scalar.

methods.name: add_scalar
methods.description: Adds a scalar to a tensor.

methods.name: mul_scalar
methods.description: Multiplies a tensor by a scalar.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Concatenates a list of tensors along a specified dimension.

methods.name: add_relu
methods.description: Adds two tensors and applies ReLU activation.

methods.name: matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication of two tensors.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Creates a QFunctional instance from a FloatFunctional, using its quantization parameters.
